wages.text: She called for raising the federal minimum wage to $15 and adjusting it for inflation, and pledged to support stronger union protections.
wages.quote: That is why Congress must increase the federal minimum wage to $15 and set it to rise with inflation.

debt.text: She pledged to protect and expand Social Security and Medicare, saying seniors earned those benefits through a lifetime of work.
debt.quote: Now, some politicians in Washington want to take away the benefits seniors across Delaware have earned.

safety.text: She said she would support criminal justice reforms focused on reentry and preventing recidivism.
safety.quote: I’ll vote to end mass incarceration, legalize marijuana and expunge convictions, and help to reimagine a system that prioritizes reentry and prevents recidivism.

immigration.text: She voted to extend Temporary Protected Status for Haitians and said she would advocate for protections for immigrant neighbors.
immigration.quote: Rather than working to make our immigration system more humane and fair, this administration is advancing a reckless immigration agenda with little regard for legal status, established protections, or basic human decency.

guns.text: She said she would support stronger background checks, an assault weapons ban, and safeguards to prevent dangerous people from getting guns.
guns.quote: When elected to Congress, I will vote to strengthen background checks, ban assault weapons, and institute safeguards to prevent dangerous individuals from getting guns.

abortion.text: She said she had supported every pro-choice bill before her in the Delaware Senate and pledged to protect reproductive freedom in Congress.
abortion.quote: I’ve supported and co-sponsored every pro-choice bill that has come before me and been a champion of bills expanding access to reproductive care in Delaware.

gender.text: She opposed a Delaware bill requiring school athletes to compete according to sex assigned at birth and helped keep it from a full Senate vote.
gender.quote: Being a trans kid in a world that so often rejects who you are is already hard enough and I don’t understand why we would pass a law that makes their lives even harder.

cannabis.text: She said she would vote to legalize marijuana and expunge convictions.
cannabis.quote: I’ll vote to end mass incarceration, legalize marijuana and expunge convictions, and help to reimagine a system that prioritizes reentry and prevents recidivism.

health.text: She supports expanding Medicare, lowering its eligibility age, and creating a public option as steps toward universal coverage.
health.quote: At a minimum, we should expand Medicare to cover dental, vision, and hearing while lowering the age of eligibility and providing a public option.

energy.text: She called for investment in renewable energy and said the United States should reach net-zero emissions as soon as possible.
energy.quote: In order to achieve net-zero emissions as soon as possible, the United States must demonstrate commitment to both domestic action and global investment.

voting.text: She supported vote by mail, early voting, and same-day registration in Delaware and pledged to back federal voting-rights legislation.
voting.quote: In the Delaware General Assembly, I have joined many of my colleagues in passing vote by mail, early voting, and same-day voter registration.

immigration.text: He says he supports ending sanctuary cities and enforcing immigration law.
immigration.quote: I agree with President Trump: end sanctuary cities and enforce the law.

guns.text: He says the Second Amendment must be upheld when asked what gun restrictions are needed for public safety.
guns.quote: The second amendment, like the rest of the constitution, must be upheld.

abortion.text: He describes himself as broadly pro-life and supports legal protection for life from conception.
abortion.quote: I'm pro-life, broadly defined, standing for life from conception to death of everyone.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly agreed that biological males should not participate in women's sports or occupy women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison. Strongly Agree

energy.text: He supports using fossil fuels and nuclear reactors to power data centers.
energy.quote: I am for relying upon (small) nuclear reactors and fossil fuel to power legitimate centers.

voting.text: He strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree
